name: XNXX
summary: Long-running sister tube to XVideos sporting a retro blue layout, ultra-lightweight pages, and a sprawling free video and erotica archive.
ranking_rationale: Shares much of WGCZ's high-volume backend catalog and snappy playback, though its bare-bones 2000s interface and weak filtering keep it behind newer tubes.

pricing.model: Ad-supported free tube + optional paid tier (XNXX Gold)
pricing.free_tier: Full free tube library and erotica stories with ads
pricing.notes: Core tube is free; XNXX Gold ad-free tier varies by plan and promo; check official checkout.

pros: Ultra-fast page loads on older phones and weak connections
Huge free catalog overlapping with XVideos' backend
Includes a long-running text erotica and photo section
cons: Unmistakably dated blue UI with basic filtering tools
Heavy catalog overlap if you already use XVideos
Frequent pop-ups and low-res legacy clips mixed into results

facts.value: Founded 1997; operated by WGCZ Holding (sister site to XVideos)
Free ad-supported tube with optional XNXX Gold paid upgrade
Low-overhead pages that load fast on mobile networks
